source_build: Derived from the immutable evaluation record each entry names: the counts of one arm of it, from which the reader works out how often a being whose mind is the model is asked and what one ask cost. Each entry is one model in one society engine of this product; no figure here sets one model beside another.
fallback: For an engine and model with no entry, show no typical figure: only the most one answer can cost.

entries.reason: A measured cost: a valid arm of the record, eight people of a living town of forty given the model and played for 120 simulated minutes. It is that town's figure on one morning. A longer arm, a larger town or another day's prices would move it, as a new version of this catalog.

The price of an ask is a measured cost, read from 91 receipts and seen again in the record's second run of 360 asks. The rate is an ESTIMATE: the arm was cut by its own stop rule after 44 simulated minutes, and its registration says a cut arm's rate is not used for a default, so every reader of it says estimate. A whole arm with the stop rule counting a model's refused answers apart from provider errors replaces it, as a new version of this catalog.
